meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检查你的 Azure 应用(仅函数应用和 Web 应用)的可靠性:看是否有区域冗余、存储冗余、健康检查和多区域故障转移,列出一张问题清单,然后在你确认后帮你修复。
howto.when: 当你说「评估可靠性」等,或提到「区域冗余」「多区域故障转移」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估 Function App 的可靠性
say.note: 生成可靠性清单并给出修复建议

say.text: 检查我的 Web 应用是否区域冗余
say.note: 扫描计算和存储,指出缺口

say.text: 为我的应用设置多区域故障转移

howto.what_en: Claude assesses reliability of Azure Functions and App Service apps: scans for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, multi-region failover, shows a checklist, then drives confirmed remediation via CLI or IaC.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to assess or check reliability, or mentions zone redundancy, multi-region failover, high availability, etc.

say_en.text: Help me assess the reliability of my Function App
say_en.note: Generates a reliability checklist and fix suggestions

say_en.text: Check whether my Web app is zone redundant
say_en.note: Scans compute and storage for gaps

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app
say_en.note: Asks for your confirmation before changes
